purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0084 in the gauge arena: in quenched SU(3) the pion mass goes like the square root of the quark mass (a Goldstone boson of broken chiral symmetry), while the same code with the gluons off gives a pion mass proportional to the quark mass.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
